subject: Re: ACP desktop defect fixes #1/#3-#6 verification complete (ref msg 1466)
body:
Verified the re-test batch in `acp-desktop` after ACP restart.

| Defect | Status | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| **#1 CRITICAL** Sandbox IPC `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'type')` | **PASS** | `src/main/preload.ts` now validates every forwarded IPC payload with `isValidPayload()` before dereferencing; malformed/empty payloads are dropped with a warning instead of crashing the renderer. All payload-bearing `ipcRenderer.on()` handlers are covered. |
| **#3 MEDIUM** Excessive mail inbox polling | **PASS** | `src/renderer/hooks/useMail.ts` now uses a stable `fetchKey` (sorted agents + project) and a `lastFetchedKeyRef` guard to skip duplicate initial fetches; `mailStore.fetchAllInboxes` accepts an `AbortSignal` to cancel in-flight requests. The per-trigger fan-out that produced repeated `GET /inboxes` calls is gone. |
| **#4 MEDIUM** Duplicate SSE connect/reconnect events | **PASS** | `src/renderer/hooks/useAcpSse.ts` adds `connectingRef` + `abortRef` idempotency guards, resets `hasConnectedRef` on mount/cleanup, and gates catch-up/reconnect logic on `!disposed`. `useVsqlCacheSse.ts` now waits for `pickerHasStarted && agentsKey` before connecting. |
| **#5 MEDIUM** Duplicate terminal spawn responses | **PASS** | `src/renderer/components/Terminal/TerminalPane.tsx` adds a per-instance `spawnPendingRef` and a global `spawnPromiseMap` to coalesce concurrent/StrictMode spawn attempts for the same agent. `src/main/pty.ts` also includes `provider` in `PTY_SPAWNED` so the renderer resolves injection behavior from the real runtime. |
| **#6 LOW** Electron security warnings in development | **PARTIAL** | `src/main/index.ts` now sets `webSecurity: !isDev` and `allowRunningInsecureContent: false`. This removes the `allowRunningInsecureContent` warning in all builds and removes the `disabled webSecurity` warning in packaged/production builds. The `disabled webSecurity` warning is still expected in dev because `webSecurity` remains `false` there intentionally (local Vite/acp-api access). |

**Regression checks:** `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --noEmit` both pass. Full test suite: **363 passed, 1 skipped** (30 test files passed). Relevant tests for the changed areas (`TerminalPane`, `mailStore`, `useVsqlCacheSse`, `agentSessionLifecycle`, `acpSessionStore`) all pass.

**Not included:** Defect **#2 HIGH** (`useVsqlCacheSse` 400 Bad Request) remains with DotNetPert per your earlier mail and was not part of this batch.

— QAPert
